name: Media Responsive Thumbnail URL Formatter
description: A media-reference field formatter that outputs a responsive thumbnail image URL.
project_description:
This module adds a Responsive URL formatter for a media reference field. This allows site builders to output the URLs to the thumbnail of the media entity and also allows to choose the responsive image style to use for the thumbnail.

 Depencencies:

 
 Media Responsive Thumbnail 
 
 Usage

 Add a media reference field to an entity.

 Go to "Manage display" settings for the entity.

 Choose 'Responsive thumbnail url' as the formatter.

 Select responsive image style from the settings.
